_comment: Source-of-truth catalog of AI-tool affiliate programs. Consumed by scripts/affiliate-audit.mjs and any future passive-income site/repo. Set ourLink when you have a signed-up affiliate URL; null = not yet joined. Researched 2026-06-05; re-verification pass 2026-07-11 against knowledge/07-field-dossier.md — entries with verifiedAt trace to the dossier; all others carry an unverified note. Verify commercial terms before relying on them — affiliate terms change often. Affiliate-term refresh 2026-09-28: entries with commissionVerifiedAt or verifiedAt 2026-09-28 were re-read against the program's own page (commissionSourceUrl); Copy.ai removed (no official terms page), Perplexity closed, Notion reopened. Second pass 2026-09-28: Topaz Labs, Rytr and Pollo AI verified; Freepik renamed Magnific (publishes no rate); Adobe terms verified but Firefly eligibility unconfirmed; Canva closed (Canvassador-only); Pika and OpenRouter have no official program; Whop re-verified.
disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. I only recommend tools I actually use or have tested.

programs.commission: up to 25% (rate rises with qualifying revenue)
programs.commissionNote: Up to 25% of the plan price on subscription purchases, renewals and upgrades for 12 months from the referral date; rate tiers up with qualifying revenue; refunded purchases earn nothing; quarterly/annual first payout held up to 90 days; referee gets up to 50% off for 3 hours. No paid ads, brand bidding or coupon/cashback sites. Applications open to anyone with an audience; link issued on signup. Cookie window not stated officially
programs.note: You use it — most authentic + highest ticket ($249/mo Creator). Re-verified 2026-09-28: the old '15% Ambassador via Impact.com' row is superseded by Higgsfield's own direct affiliate program (higgsfield.ai/affiliate, up to 25% for 12 months). Separate 'Earn' program pays for social posting (not blog). Also: https://higgsfield.ai/blog/higgsfield-affiliate-program-2026
Highest recurring % on the list, lifetime, no gate. The compounding spine.

programs.commission: up to 35% recurring (tiered by referral volume)
programs.commissionNote: Up to 35% recurring commission on qualifying new CapCut Pro subscribers from the US, UK, Germany and France; tiers rise with referral count; the page advertises up to $15,000 in commissions without stating a period; paid monthly via Impact ($10 minimum). Recurring duration and cookie window are not stated on the official page
programs.note: Massive install base, easy convert. Re-verified 2026-09-28 (capcut.com/partners/affiliate-program): up to 35% recurring via Impact, US/UK/DE/FR subscribers only; cookie and recurring duration not published.

programs.commissionNote: 22% of payments for the first 12 months on Starter/Creator/Pro/Scale plans; 11% on Business; paid via PartnerStack at the end of the third month after the commission is earned. The official terms do not state a cookie window
programs.note: Recurring for 12 months + extremely demoable/viral. Re-verified 2026-09-28 against the official terms; the 90-day cookie came from third parties and is not stated officially.

programs.commission: 20% of every payment for up to 12 months
programs.commissionNote: 20% of every payment for up to 12 months per referral; 60-day last-click cookie; paid monthly via FirstPromoter
programs.note: AI writing / AI-search visibility tool. Terms re-verified 2026-09-28 against the official affiliate page; this resolves the earlier conflict (the '30% lifetime, up to 40%' reading was roundup-sourced and wrong).

programs.commission: 85% of the first month's subscription (8.33% of year one on prepaid annual plans)
programs.commissionNote: One-time commission, not recurring: 85% of one month's fee on eligible monthly and annual-paid-monthly plans (Creative Cloud including single apps, Adobe Express, Document Cloud); 8.33% of the first year on prepaid annual plans; Adobe Stock has separate rates. 30-day cookie. Trial, cancelled, invalid and fraud orders earn $0. Run on Partnerize, and Adobe reviews each application. The page does not list Firefly plans by name
programs.note: Adobe brand trust. The image-post monetization target (since Midjourney/Ideogram/FLUX have no program). Adobe's program terms were re-verified on 2026-09-28 (adobe.com/affiliates.html). The old '~30% recurring, 60-day cookie, Partnerize/Impact' row was wrong: Adobe pays a one-time 85% of the first month (8.33% of year one on prepaid annual) with a 30-day cookie, via Partnerize. Firefly eligibility is NOT confirmed, because the page lists Creative Cloud (including single apps), Adobe Express, Document Cloud and Adobe Stock but never names Firefly plans. The row is therefore held at verify, and ourLink is cleared (was go.agenticincome.ai/firefly) until Partnerize confirms that Firefly plans earn commission.

programs.commission: 25% for the first 12 months (30% after 100 leads + 100 conversions in a rolling 12 months)
programs.commissionNote: Creator/Teams (non-enterprise) plans only; the lead must purchase within 14 days of the first click; $25 minimum payout
programs.note: Deprioritized 2026-06-07 — Frank not a fan, not a brand fit. Skip unless reconsidered. Terms re-verified 2026-09-28 against Jasper's affiliate agreement; jasper.ai/partners now redirects to the agency Solutions Partner program, so the agreement is the canonical affiliate page.

Priority. AI presentation maker — the pick in best-ai-presentation-maker + ultimate-gamma-workflow posts. Re-verified 2026-09-28: Gamma's partner terms state a 60-day cookie and monthly PartnerStack payouts but publish no commission rate (the earlier '30% for 12 mo, 90d' reading was third-party-sourced). Confirm the rate inside PartnerStack before publishing a number.

programs.commission: 35% for the first 3 months (Social Creator Program)
programs.commissionNote: Social Creator Program: 35% of each subscription for 3 months; 30-day tracking; commissions clear a 60-day verification hold; $100 minimum payout via PayPal. Open to creators with 5K+ followers; original video content only (no SEO/blog-only promotion, paid search, or self-referrals). A temporary 50% rate for Aug 1–Oct 31, 2026 is not reflected here
programs.note: AI avatar leader — recommended across faceless-youtube + heygen-vs-synthesia posts. Re-verified 2026-09-28: the official program is a video-creator program that excludes blog-only/SEO promotion, so blog placements may not qualify. ourLink cleared (was go.agenticincome.ai/heygen) until eligibility is confirmed; restore it only for an eligible channel.

programs.commission: 25% of net payments for 12 months (Starter/Creator plans)
programs.commissionNote: 25% of the net amount of payments from a qualified customer on Starter and Creator plans; a customer stays qualified for 12 months from first purchase; must register within 60 days of the click; paid monthly once due commission exceeds $30; no self-referrals; tracked in Rewardful. Milestone perks: free Starter account after 10 sales, free personal avatar after 15
programs.note: Enterprise AI avatar — heygen-vs-synthesia post. Re-verified 2026-09-28: synthesia.io/affiliates now redirects to the generic /partners hub, so signupUrl points at /partners/affiliates. Terms: synthesia.io/terms/affiliate-terms.

programs.commissionNote: 25% of the subscription sale price for up to 12 consecutive months from the initial sale (monthly renewals count; stops if the referral cancels); paid monthly on the 15th via PayPal once earnings reach $20; approval takes about a week; inactive links deactivated after 6 months; no paid advertising or coupon sites; tracked via Rewardful. Cookie window not stated officially. The affiliate page FAQ says "as long as the person remains subscribed", but the terms cap it at 12 months
programs.note: Long→short repurposing — faceless-youtube stack. Re-verified 2026-09-28 (opus.pro/affiliate-terms): 25% for up to 12 months, Rewardful, $20 minimum payout.

programs.commission: 20% (monthly plans: 20% of each payment for up to 12 months)
programs.commissionNote: 20% commission. Annual-commitment subscriptions: 20% of that sale. Monthly subscriptions: 20% of each monthly payment for up to 12 months. 30-day cookie. Paid monthly via PayPal with a $50 minimum. In-house program; the Topaz marketing team reviews applications
programs.note: Strong 'AI upscaling' SEO intent. Re-verified 2026-09-28 (topazlabs.com/affiliates): 20% with a 30-day cookie; monthly plans pay for up to 12 months and annual plans pay once. The old one-time AOV note is dropped because Topaz now sells subscriptions.

No official affiliate program found for Pika (pika.art, the video generator) on 2026-09-28. pika.art/affiliate and /affiliates only redirect to the app login, and pika.art publishes no affiliate terms. The '30% recurring' figure belongs to pika.style, a different company that makes screenshot and mockup tools. Terms and ourLink removed (fail-closed). Watch for a program.

programs.commissionNote: Freepik is now Magnific. There are two programs and you can join only one. 'Refer & earn' gives your audience a discount code and pays a commission when a referred user starts their first paid subscription. The publisher 'Affiliate' program is marked 'Coming soon'. No commission rate, duration or cookie window is published. Self-referrals do not count, and only brand-safe channels are allowed
programs.note: Formerly Freepik (renamed here to match the program). Re-verified 2026-09-28: freepik.com/affiliates now redirects to magnific.com/affiliates, which publishes no rate. The old '30% recurring / 20% one-time' figure has no official source and is removed. ourLink cleared (was go.agenticincome.ai/freepik) until a rate is confirmed inside the program.

Affiliate program closed to new applicants. canva.com/affiliates now redirects to a Help Center article saying affiliate benefits come only through the Canvassador Program, which is currently closed for applications. Existing affiliates must reapply, and program details are shared only after acceptance. The old 'up to $36/signup via Impact' figure is removed. Verified 2026-09-28. Watch for applications to reopen.

programs.commissionNote: $25 one-time per new qualifying subscription; purchase must happen within 30 days of the first click; initial term only, no renewals; PartnerStack
programs.note: Was 15% recurring; cut to $25 flat in early 2024 — object lesson in program-term drift. Re-verified 2026-09-28 (descript.com/affiliate-terms): $25 flat, 30-day window from first click (the earlier 90-day figure was wrong), PartnerStack.

programs.commissionNote: 30% of each referred paying customer's payments for 12 months from their subscription date, and nothing after that. Paid on the 1st of the month, at least 30 days after conversion, via PayPal with a $100 minimum. No Google Ads at all, no brand-keyword ads on other channels, no Rytr brand in your domain, no self-referrals. The official terms do not state a cookie window
programs.note: Low ticket. Re-verified 2026-09-28 against the official terms (affiliates.rytr.me/terms, a Rewardful-hosted portal, last updated 2025-09-30): 30% for 12 months per customer. The old 'lifetime' reading was wrong.

programs.commission: Seller-set per product (Whop's default global rate is 30%)
programs.commissionNote: Marketplace model: each seller sets its own affiliate rate. Whop's default global affiliate rate is 30%, and sellers can change it, set a separate rate for their members, or offer custom deals (percent or fixed amount, on recurring payments or the first payment only). Commissions reach the affiliate 30 days after the referred purchase and go back to the seller on refunds, disputes or fraud. Whop Partners is a separate program for referring businesses onto Whop: its page lists 30% of the revenue Whop earns from those businesses, 1% of their ad spend, and a second tier
programs.note: Marketplace with per-product affiliate terms. Re-verified 2026-09-28 against Whop's docs (docs.whop.com/manage-your-business/growth-marketing/affiliate-program and /affiliates/setup-global) and whop.com/partners. The 30% figure is only a default that each seller can change, so check the specific product's rate before publishing any Whop terms.

No official affiliate or referral program found on 2026-09-28. openrouter.ai/affiliates returns a 404 page, and OpenRouter's FAQ, docs and Terms of Service describe no affiliate commission. The 2026-08-16 'one-time commission, 60-day cookie' row had no official source and is removed. Watch for a program.

programs.commission: 30% on first purchases, renewals and upgrades
programs.commissionNote: 30% of every first purchase, renewal or upgrade by customers you refer (upgrades earn on the price difference). A second tier pays 10% on sales by affiliates you recruit. Refunded sales are deducted. Paid via PayPal between the 10th and 15th of each month, with a $100 minimum. No coupon sites. Paid ads may not use the Pollo brand name or logo, or pollo.ai destination URLs. The official page does not state a renewal duration or cookie window
programs.note: Aggregator backdoor to monetize Seedance/Veo/Sora/Kling/Hailuo, the models with no direct program. Re-verified 2026-09-28 (pollo.ai/affiliate-program): 30% on first purchases, renewals and upgrades via Tapfiliate; the renewal duration and cookie window are not published.

programs.commission: Up to $50 per activated signup + 20% of year-one revenue
programs.commissionNote: Paid when a new workspace upgrades to Plus or Business within 180 days of the click; last-click attribution; rewards can be clawed back on a downgrade or refund in the first 2 months; Notion requires FTC-compliant disclosure
programs.note: Reopened to new affiliates (re-verified 2026-09-28; it was closed on 2026-07-11). Not joined yet, so ourLink stays null until approval.

No affiliate program. High-traffic comparison keyword, zero monetization — route to adjacent payers. Dossier-verified 2026-07-11: no public affiliate program; OpenAI Partner Network is an enterprise reseller/ISV track, not an affiliate scheme.
No affiliate program. Dossier-verified 2026-07-11: no consumer/creator program; the Claude Partner Network (June 2026, $100M fund) is enterprise reseller/SI only.
No consumer AI affiliate program (Veo, Gemini, Nano Banana). no-program status not re-verified 2026-07-11

No program. Route image posts to Adobe Firefly (Canva's program is closed; Freepik/Magnific publishes no rate). no-program status not re-verified 2026-07-11
No program found. no-program status not re-verified 2026-07-11
Model lab / API — no consumer referral layer. no-program status not re-verified 2026-07-11
Program CLOSED Apr 7 2026 — no new applicants. closure status not re-verified 2026-07-11

Referral program closed. Perplexity's Help Center says the Comet Referral Program (run on Dub Partners) ended on Nov 6, 2025 and no new referrals are accepted. Verified 2026-09-28. The old '~$15 per US referral' figure has been removed. Watch for a new program.
